home.faqWhenA: Usually on Tuesdays and Fridays around 9pm (Paris time). Exact times are set by the operators. This site shows the latest published result and a countdown to the next draw.
home.faqCheckQ: How do I check a EuroMillions grid?
home.faqCheckA: Use the simulator: pick 5 numbers and 2 stars, then the draw date. The tool compares your grid with the official result and shows the prize tier if any. We do not validate physical tickets.
home.faqMyMillionA: My Million is a unique code attached to EuroMillions grids played in France. The My Million prize is separate from the jackpot. The My Million page lists published codes and lets you compare yours.
home.faqTicketsA: No. EuroMillions Results is an independent editorial site: results, archives and tools. To play, use a licensed operator in your country. 18+ · play responsibly.

stats.title: EuroMillions statistics
stats.subtitle: Observed frequencies and delays on the local history — descriptive only, not a forecast.
stats.howBody: “Drawn” counts appearances in the local history. “Delay” is how many draws since the last appearance. A long delay does not make a number more likely next time: every ball stays equally likely.
stats.howExpected: Over a long history, each ball (1–50) should appear about as often (five balls per draw). Observed gaps are statistical noise, not a signal.
stats.disclaimer: Past frequencies do not predict the next draw. No system beats the odds.
stats.meta: EuroMillions frequencies, delays and jackpots — local history.
stats.expectedLine: Expected average per number on this history: ~{expected} hits (5 balls × draws / 50).
stats.freqLead: Bar height = appearances in the local archive. Not a forecast.
stats.delayLead: Bar height = draws since last appearance. A long gap does not raise the next-draw chance.
stats.howForm: “Form 10 / 30” counts appearances in the last 10 and 30 draws. Not a prediction.

legal.cookiesIntro: This section describes the cookies used on EuroMillions Results. You can manage cookies via the banner (footer link).
legal.independent: EuroMillions Results is an independent editorial site. It is not operated by FDJ or EuroMillions operators.
legal.affiliateBody: Product links may be Amazon affiliate links. The price you pay does not change. AdSense units are labelled “Advertisement”. No EuroMillions ticket sales. Not affiliated with FDJ or EuroMillions operators.
legal.adsense: This site may show Google AdSense ads. Google may use cookies to personalize ads, only after your consent.
legal.cookiesAdsBody: Only after your consent: Google AdSense may set cookies to measure and personalize ads. If you reject them, the site remains usable without personalized ads.
legal.privacyBody: We collect minimal technical data (server logs) and anonymised audience measurement via Umami (self-hosted, no advertising cookie). If you accept, Google AdSense advertising cookies may also apply. The contact form sends name, email and message only so we can reply. No resale of personal data.
legal.privacyConsent: You can accept or reject advertising cookies via the cookie banner. Strictly necessary cookies remain active. Technical measures: HTTPS, security headers, contact-form spam limits.
legal.privacyBasisBody: Legal bases: legitimate interest (security, technical logs, anonymised audience), pre-contractual steps / responding to your request (contact form), and consent (AdSense advertising cookies). Retention: technical logs for a limited period (a few weeks), contact messages for as long as needed to handle them, consent choice stored locally on your device until deleted.
legal.responsibleBody: Lottery games involve a risk of loss. Adults only (18+).
